description: US History PhD metadata harvest, tier 2 (feasibility survey us-dissertations-feasibility-2026-10-13): UNC (Hyrax), UVA (Libra ETD), Florida (UFDC) and the robots-restricted DSpace 7 sites Kansas, Arizona and Temple. Each stream names an adapter, its listing route and the exact client-side keep rules ('department', 'degree'), which tier 1's build_record applies unchanged (equals = case/accent-insensitive whole-value match; regex = re.search; extract = take regex group 1 first). Non-DSpace records are crosswalked to DSpace-style metadata fields first; the synthetic field names (unc.*, uva.*, ufdc.*) are listed in the README.

streams.institution_name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
streams.listing_route: DataCite DOIs (prefix 10.17615, resourceType Dissertation) plus the CDR sitemap -> /concern/dissertations/<id>.json for every work -> work page (citation_pdf_url) for kept works only; crawl-delay 8 s

department.note: creators[].affiliation; Art History is 'Department of Art and Art History', so whole-value equality excludes it

degree.note: Legacy CDR works (mostly 2007-2012) have no degree; DataCite types them Dissertation (not Masters Thesis). They are kept, but count as History PhDs only when matched to an AHA History PhD; otherwise needs_review.

streams.rule_description: CDR dissertation work; creators[].affiliation == Department of History; degree == Doctor of Philosophy

streams.listing_route: Libra ETD sitemap.xml (every public_view work) -> /api/works/<id>?for=view; DataCite (prefix 10.18130) titles only to order the requests

equals: History - Graduate School of Arts and Sciences

streams.rule_description: Libra ETD program is the History department (three spellings by era); degree == PHD (Doctor of Philosophy)

streams.listing_route: UFDC JSON API exactsearch (four queries, union, paged with start=) -> /<bibid>/<vid>/downloads for public kept items only

department.note: ufdc.department = etd_degree_discipline plus the department named in the subject headings '<Dept> thesis, Ph.D.' and '<Dept> | Dissertations, Academic | UF'; 'Art History' etc. do not match

streams.rule_description: UFDC ETD/thesis record; department History (etd_degree_discipline or '<Dept> thesis, Ph.D.' heading); doctoral level or 'Thesis (Ph.D.)' note; open only if accesscode == public and embargo past

streams.listing_route: robots.txt disallows /server/api and /server/oai: sitemap_index.xml (inventory) + OpenAlex works for the repository (type dissertation, off-site) -> candidate item pages /handle/<handle> (server-side render, crawl-delay 10 s)

department.note: thesis.degree.discipline is ['Graduate College', 'History']: the granting college is set aside, the remaining value must be History

streams.rule_description: thesis.degree.discipline == History (besides Graduate College); thesis.degree.level == doctoral
